title: 平缝机控制器 CTRL-LS
summary: 单相 110–250 V 进、驱动 550 W 直驱伺服的一块板：功率因数校正、智能功率模块、反激辅助电源、磁场定向控制、电磁铁和针距步进驱动。整理第 138 轮 GC 的控制仿真（起停、停针）和第 159 轮的板子报告（电气、工艺、热，真器件型号），看平缝机出厂测试里的停针定位误差。
summary_en: One board from 110–250 V single phase to a 550 W direct-drive servo: PFC, intelligent power module, flyback auxiliary supply, field-oriented control, solenoid and stitch-stepper drives. Round 138 GC control simulation (start, stop, needle positioning) and round 159 board report (electrical, process, thermal, real parts) organised; needle-stop error from the end-of-line test.
honest: 示例设计：经计算和仿真校核，没有实物试制；数值为示例值。
honest_en: Example design: checked by calculation and simulation, not built and tested; all values are examples.

steps.title: 任务书
steps.summary: 90–250 V 单相进、390 V 母线、550 W 直驱伺服；停针 ±1°。
steps.summary_en: 90–250 V single phase, 390 V bus, 550 W direct-drive servo; needle stop ±1°.

steps.title: 方案
steps.summary: 功率和主控做在一块板上，主控以母线负端为地、对人能碰到的接口隔离；磁场定向控制 + 缝纫状态机。
steps.summary_en: Power and control on one board, control referenced to bus minus, isolated towards touchable ports; FOC plus a sewing state machine.

steps.title: 计算
steps.summary: 母线 390 V、输入约 7.9 A；功能块校核：通过 9、不通过 0、待核对 60（第 159 轮在做）。
steps.summary_en: 390 V bus, about 7.9 A input; block checks: 9 pass, 0 fail, 60 pending (round 159 in progress).

steps.title: 仿真
steps.summary: 速度环 40 Hz：98 ms 到 5000 r/min，停针误差 -0.04°；板上最热 102 ℃。
steps.summary_en: 40 Hz speed loop: 5000 rpm in 98 ms, needle stop error -0.04°; hottest board spot 102 °C.

figs.caption: 一个工作周期（GC 仿真）

steps.title: 三维与图纸
steps.summary: KiCad 工程由设计描述生成；物料清单 95 行（真型号、立创编号）；顶层铜、三维模型。
steps.summary_en: KiCad project generated from the design description; 95-line BOM (real parts, LCSC numbers); top copper and 3D model.

steps.title: 工艺
steps.summary: 贴片可制造性 15 项：不通过 0；进厂后在出厂测试工位烧固件、量停针。
steps.summary_en: 15 manufacturability checks, 0 failed; firmware flashed and needle stop measured at end-of-line.

steps.title: 制造
steps.summary: 40 台出厂测试：停针误差 Cpk 1.62，不合格 0。
steps.summary_en: 40 machines at end-of-line: needle-stop Cpk 1.62, 0 failures.

steps.title: 总结
steps.summary: 6 / 6 项校核通过；待核对 60 项（第 159 轮在做）。
steps.summary_en: 6 / 6 checks pass; 60 items pending (round 159 in progress).
